name: STL Viewer, OBJ Viewer, GLB & glTF Viewer
summary: 从 Open VSX 获取此扩展，即可在 VS Code 中检查 STL、OBJ 和 glTF/GLB 模型。据发布者介绍，扩展可离线运行，并支持点到点测距、线框视图和 glTF 动画播放。

Get the viewer from Open VSX to inspect STL, OBJ, and glTF/GLB models in VS Code. The publisher says it works offline and supports point-to-point measurements, wireframe views, and glTF animation playback.
